evidence: Ministry of the Interior (MUP), working-group leadership and four appointed places including chair/deputy; the government adopts the plan.
qualification: Government leadership seat, not sole strategy authorship

evidence: Working group submits annual needs and a financial plan; Interior Minister approves; MUP manages dedicated state budget project K553092. No Finance Ministry working-group seat established.
qualification: Narrow functional financing interface, not a treasury seat

evidence: MUP is a formal member and responsible for police enforcement activities and crash investigation.
Ministry of Justice and Administration has a formal appointed member in the implementation working group.
qualification: Formal ministry link; no direct victim legal-aid assignment inferred

evidence: Croatian Firefighting Association (HVZ) is assigned joint responder training and drills in the national action tables but is not named as a standing group member.
qualification: Operational partner, not permanent council seat

evidence: Centre for Vehicles of Croatia (CVH) is a working-group member with vehicle testing roles; this does not verify representation of vehicle manufacturers.
qualification: Vehicle technical-assurance link, not a manufacturing ministry

evidence: Faculty of Transport and Traffic Sciences participates as a formal expert institution, with traffic-engineering and safety-audit training in plan activities; no construction-industry seat.
Croatian Roads and Croatian Motorways each have a formal group member; both are named in infrastructure actions.
Ministry of the Sea, Transport and Infrastructure (MMPI) has two working-group positions; driver/carrier and inspection activity responsibilities.
MUP, road managers, local authorities and public health partners are assigned integrated collision/traffic-flow and medical-data measures. No separate digital ministry seat established.
qualification: Digital-data implementation interface, not formal digital portfolio

evidence: No environmental ministry working-group seat or specific interministerial environmental road-safety responsibility verified.
Local government units (JLS) are assigned road-safety audits, urban crossings and local road treatment in plan tables but have no verified permanent working-group place.
Ministry of Health has a formal group member; Ministry and emergency medical bodies are assigned post-crash activities.

Croatian Automobile Club (HAK) has an explicit working-group seat and contributed to expert plan development; this establishes a national road-user/civil-society organization, not representation of every local community.
qualification: Formal non-government participant, local groups N/A

evidence: Ministry of Science and Education has a formal group member; road safety learning and teacher training assigned to education partners.

Croatian Insurance Bureau (HUO) has a formal place, but a specific government social-protection / disability authority or comprehensive survivor benefits mandate is not established. Its financial/insurance link is documented separately.
qualification: Insurance membership is not proof of social protection coverage

evidence: Mountain rescue and emergency services participate in drills, but a mass-casualty civil-protection or disaster-preparedness mandate of the working group is not established.
qualification: Rescue participation does not establish civil-defence authority
